name: Species sticking, residence-time, and re-emission distribution verification
purpose: Verify compiled surface-temperature and sticking kernels while explicitly separating absent residence-time/inventory physics.
production_capability: Exosphere::GetSurfaceTemperature, SodiumStickingProbability, ArgonStickingProbability, and surface interaction dispatch.
configuration: Current Yakshinskiy2005SS Na mode generated from moon.input; analytical cosine temperature.
independent_reference: Closed-form cosine-temperature values and frozen tabulated/piecewise sticking control points.
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred solar-orbital frame; static non-eclipsed fixture.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Kernel calls are deterministic; stochastic Bernoulli/re-emission distributions remain for linked testing.
procedure: Call compiled temperature and sticking kernels at breakpoints; do not claim residence-time or inventory verification.
acceptance_criteria: Control values within 1e-14 relative or exact where integral; all probabilities in [0,1].
expected_pass_result: Available deterministic kernels match their frozen references.
data_hashes: none; the digitized Na table embedded in production is regression input, not observational validation
status_semantics: PASS covers only temperature/sticking kernels; residence time, inventory, and stochastic re-emission remain unverified and require I18/I19.
